title: FBI database hack reported as investigation opens
excerpt: The FBI is reportedly looking into a security breach involving the National Crime Information Center database.
body_html:
The FBI is reportedly conducting an investigation into a security breach affecting the National Crime Information Center database.

When asked about the situation, comments indicated that the reported incident involving the federal law enforcement database is "not good."

Further details regarding the nature of the breach, potential data exposure, or who may be responsible have not been disclosed as the investigation remains ongoing.
